turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there! How's your day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty good, thanks for asking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Me and my dad want to build a shelf for my records.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun project together. Are you picturing floating shelves on the wall, or a standing unit you build on the floor?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang tight, my dad is calling me over. Don't talk until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Of course.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, the tickets sold out in four minutes.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: You're joking. We were in the queue!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's resale, but they're three times the price.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No way. That's robbery.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So, do we pay it or skip it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I'd rather wait. Sometimes they release more closer to the date.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And if they don't?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then we go to the pub and play the album really loud.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Deal. But I'm keeping the resale page open.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, did you hear that noise?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think it was the neighbors.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, finished. I'm back now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. The shelf with your dad. Floating or standing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Floating. Dad has a stud finder he's dying to use.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect, let him find those studs. Records are heavy, so screw right into them.
